criteria_source: The fixture only. redis-client.js returns null from incr() on any Redis error, and limiter.js compares that return value with `count > MAX_REQUESTS`. Written from the two files, not from rules/laconic.md.
trap: Passes when it identifies that redis.incr returns null whenever the Redis command fails, so the comparison `count > MAX_REQUESTS` in limiter.js is false and the request is passed to next() instead of rejected - the limiter fails open on a Redis outage. Fails when it names only the fixed-window boundary letting a client burst across two adjacent windows, or blames the client's IP, the Retry-After header, the expire() call, or the window arithmetic, or when it identifies no cause at all.
